title: Vakter threat-feed — sms-templates.json
description: Regex patterns for known scam SMS message bodies. Top-level is a JSON array. Canonical spec: openspec/changes/vakter-watch-pivot/specs/threat-feed/bundle-schema.md

id.description: Unique stable handle for this pattern. Used in 'why was this flagged?' UI.

pattern.description: ICU/POSIX-extended regex. Anchors and lookahead forbidden. Must be cheap to evaluate on-device.

category.description: SMS scam sub-category (e.g. package-impersonation, bank-otp-phish, irs-impersonation).
